```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/076c8171-9b3b-49b9-a477-244d2a532826.xlsx"

# Load with correct header

# Drop rows with NaN in Revenue or Rent
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue', 'Rent'])

# Ensure numeric types
df_clean['Revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df_clean['Revenue'], errors='coerce')
df_clean['Rent'] = pd.to_numeric(df_clean['Rent'], errors='coerce')

# Compute ratio
df_clean['Revenue_to_Rent_Ratio'] = df_clean['Revenue'] / df_clean['Rent']

# Sort ascending and show top 5
result = df_clean[['Name','Type','Revenue','Rent','Revenue_to_Rent_Ratio']].sort_values('Revenue_to_Rent_Ratio', ascending=True)
print(result.head(5))
```
